page0.text:
Well, it might be good to see how Fuji-nee's doing, sort of a way to get in some light after-meal exercise.
"Yeah. I'll try getting back at her for telling Sakura that embarrassing story."
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page0:1

page1.text:
"Hm? Oh, I thought you were taking a bath."
Fuji-nee is silently peeling tangerines, eating them for dessert.
Two tangerine peels shaped like floating flowers are lying on top of the table.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page1:1

page2.text:
"..."
I feel like she's been cursed or something. She can't peel apples to save her life, but her tangerine peels are like works of art.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page2:1

page3.text:
"I've decided to take a bath later. I've got a bone to pick with you about the stories you told earlier."
"What? Oh, let it go, will you? That stuff was from a long time ago and Sakura was real happy to hear about it. Anyway...here. You need to fulfill your quota. You gotta eat at least one a day."
She takes a small tangerine out from a basket on the table and tosses it to me.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page3:1

page4.text:
"Whoa. Hey, you're not gonna win me over with a tangerine.
It's a good thing you only told Sakura, but never tell stories like that at school. People like Issei would be concerned. It wouldn't be good."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page4:1

page5.text: "I bet Mitsuzuri would be rolling on the floor laughing if she heard the story. Kidding, kidding. I know. I won't talk about your childhood other than to Sakura."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page5:1

page6.text:
"That's not my point. I'm saying don't talk about it to Sakura either. I'm sure Sakura doesn't like hearing boring-ass stories like that. And...I know you won't do it again, but if you do, I'll get real mad."
I glare at Fuji-nee with all my might, showing how serious I am.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page6:1

page7.text:
"Ohhh. Oh I see. I get it. So that's what this is about, Shirou."
Despite my efforts, Fuji-nee grins, clearly pleased with herself.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page7:1

page8.text:
"Oh, for... You're really starting to piss me off. Why do you look so pleased with yourself, you dumb tiger?"
I scowl angrily at Fuji-nee.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page8:1

page9.text:
"You can call me tiger all you want. But let me get this straight: you didn't want Sakura to hear that story.
You don't care if anyone else knows you want to become a champion of justice. But you're embarrassed about Sakura finding out."
"Wha...!"
Th-that's not...true... I think.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page9:1

page10.text:
"Okay, okay. Theeen...I'm gonna keep on blabbing.
Awww, Shirou has finally noticed Sakura.
I'm a little concerned as an educator, but I'm relieved as your guardian. And at the same time, I might be a little heartbroken as your big sister."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page10:1

page11.text:
Her speech is almost weirdly emotional, and then half a heartbeat later, she shoves a whole tangerine into her mouth.
Fuji-nee can fit anything up to the size of her fist in her mouth.
An act like that might be alluring if we were in the wild savanna or something, but such feral charm seems kind of unbecoming for a mature woman like her.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page11:1

page12.text:
"Oh? Weren't you taking a bath?"
In comes Sakura.
She heads right into the living room, having finished up with the dishes.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page12:1

page13.text:
"I put it off because there was something I had to talk to Fuji-nee about. Want a tangerine, Sakura?"
I reach over for the stack of tangerines in a basket.
It's unexpected, but the three of us relaxing together after dinner is kind of nice.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page13:1

page14.text:
"Oh, Ms. Fujimura offered me some already. She saved some just for me, and they were delicious."
"Sakura doesn't like to eat fresh fruit.
She can only eat them if they're cooked or frozen like ice cream. Oh hey, isn't it getting late, Sakura?"
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page14:1

page15.text:
"Yes. I've finished cleaning up, so I'll be heading home now."
"Got it. I guess it's time for me to go too. Let's go together, Sakura. I'll walk you home since it's been dangerous outside lately."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page15:1

page16.text:
Fuji-nee halts her mass consumption of tangerines and gets to her feet, somehow managing to look bold.
The way she gets up gives the impression of a responsible elder.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page16:1

page17.text:
"Eh...are you sure?"
"Of course. I'm responsible for both you and Shirou, so I need to make sure you get home safe. You don't mind, right, Shirou? Don't forget to lock up once the two of us leave."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page17:1

page18.text:
"Got it. As long as you're with Sakura, I won't worry, even if you're attacked by perverts...or bears."
"I don't know about bears. Not sure I can do much against a bear, so Sakura and I will run right back here if that happens. Then the two of us will beat the bear up together and we'll have bear stew for dinner the next day."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page18:1

page19.text:
Fuji-nee smiles fearlessly.
...Yeah.
Fuji-nee typically marches to a different beat...a beat so loud and discordant it wreaks havoc on everything around her, but as a teacher, she's also so courageous it's almost admirable."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-11:page19:1
